topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I just found out that my favorite restaurant is closing. It’s hard to take in, knowing that place which had become a sort of comfort zone, a little spot of familiarity and joy, will soon be just a memory. I can’t help but think about all the times I could have gone there, but didn’t, all the meals I could have shared with friends and family. Maybe I should have been more regular, brought more business their way. It’s closing down, and with it, a piece of my routine, my little escapes, will vanish. I’ll have to find a new place, but it won’t be the same.
